      "research_entry": "Conditional finite protocol. Take a nonprincipal primitive Dirichlet character modulo q>1 and a uniformly translated starting phase s; measure the complex fluctuation chi(s+j), or use a primitive real quadratic character if real residuals are desired. A rational finite convolution receiver is blind for every shift precisely when its polynomial contains Phi_q.
